correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the unit-row projection in rotating radial/tangential coordinates: a step-s edge gives sin(sx)(a_j+a_{j+s})+cos(sx)(b_{j+s}-b_j). The unitary Fourier transform gives the stated blocks and preserves the singular spectrum, with conjugation pairing real modes. Writing kmx=mπ/2−mx/2 gives the two determinant factors; on 1≤m≤(n−1)/2 they vanish only at m=1. Together with m=0 and its conjugate partner for m=1 this gives just the rotation and two translations, also for n=5. For fixed odd m the scaled block H_m has determinant (m²−1)/2 and squared Frobenius norm 5(m²+1)/4, giving the stated smaller singular value at 3 and the strict lower comparison for odd m≥5. The even-mode limit is 2m in units of x, and the positive branches of modes 1 and 0 respectively give √10 in those units and a positive unscaled limit. The determinant/Frobenius bound gives s_min≥cmx on the entire folded nonrigid range (odd determinant of order (mx)² and norm O(mx); even determinant of order mx and bounded norm). Thus any minimizing folded frequency is in a fixed finite set; strict separation identifies only the smaller m=3 branch and its conjugate eventually. Restricting to the orthogonal complement of the motion kernel proves sharpness. The frozen finite checker was inspected, not executed; no finite observation is used in place of the uniform estimate.
